findings.body: The response renders the configured contact address into version 1 on every read. If that address changes, the same published version serves different text without a new version. The acceptance endpoint also records the address at acceptance time, which can differ from what the member just read. Store the rendered text with the published version, or publish a new version when its text changes.
findings.title: Not done: retain each notice version's exact published text

findings.body: The test helper signs in every member with `listed@example.in`. Consequently, the assertion on the second member's email still passes if the API accidentally returns the first member's email. Use distinct allowed emails and assert that each member receives only their own Google email.
findings.title: Not done: test cross-member email isolation
